name: Activation / Grounding
description: Grounding or activation exercise to help rider connect with present moment and physical sensations.
instructions: Place your horse and yourself in a safe, low-demand context (halt or easy walk) before starting this tool.

Follow this focus: Take a deep breath and center yourself. Stay with rhythm. Notice what's working. Keep it easy. Name 3 things you see; light bilateral taps for 60–90s. Ground feet, micro-move, add energy with voice cue..  End with a calm breath, a soft hand, and note one small win before moving on.
Continue for the suggested duration or several breaths/strides, then return to normal riding and briefly notice what feels different.
evidence_base: Grounding techniques from trauma-informed therapy, activation strategies, and equine-assisted somatic work.
